_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::thermal#4. Two standalone PROBLEMTYPE: Thermo decks identical except for the material: MAT_Fourier runs to a CORRECT result test and exit 0; MAT_scatra (DIFFUSIVITY) exits 139 on three runs out of three. The rule holds; the Signal did not. The claim said 'NO 4C output at all - no message'. In fact 4C reads the deck, builds the mesh, prints 'fill_complete() on discretization thermo' and 'Welcome to Thermal Time Integration', and only then segfaults inside the Thermo::TimIntImpl constructor, which OpenMPI's handler names in its backtrace (SCATRA_BACKTRACE_NAMES_TIMINTIMPL=1). What is genuinely absent is a FOUR_C_THROW: SCATRA_FOUR_C_ERROR_BLOCKS=0, no 'PROC 0 ERROR'. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
